148
P[ro]. M[emoria].
In dem Tableaux was Glenck Ewr Hochfürstliche Durchlaucht eben
alle Revenuen der S. P. Güter gegeben hat steht
Swięcia 1800 rthl jährliche Zinsen und 10000 rt Capital.
Bey heut geendigter Revision der Taxatoren trägt Swięcia
nur 918 rt Zinsen jährlich — der Verstoß ist zu künfig¬
und das ſchöne Gut ist beym Himmel verſchleudert.
Es hat 3792 Morgen und hätte eben so viel Tausend rt.
Mannen bringen müßen. Es ist aber für 10000 rt Capital
und 918 rt. Zinsen, und folglich für 28360 rt wegegeben worden,
wodurch ein offenbarer Verlust von 47340 rt Ewr Durch
laucht erwächſt.
Wann hierzu der Olesnicer Verlust mit 48000 rt gegen den
jezigen Verkauf genommen wird so verliere Ewr Durchlaucht an diese
beide, Güter Netto 95340 rthl — und eben
solcher Ausfall entsteht jezt bey der Taxe.
Trąbczyn
den 2ten Xbr 1804.
v Triebenfeld

translation.en:
148

P[ro]. M[emoria].

In the table which Glenck has just given Your Most Serene Highness of all the revenues of the South Prussian estates, Swięcia stands at 1,800 Rthl in annual interest and 10,000 Rthl capital. Upon the appraisers' revision concluded today, Swięcia yields only 918 Rthl interest yearly — the error is [uncertain: zu künfig] and the fine estate has, by Heaven, been squandered away. It has 3,792 Morgen and ought to have fetched just as many thousand rt. [uncertain: Mannen]. It has, however, been given away for 10,000 Rthl capital and 918 Rthl interest, and consequently for 28,360 Rthl, whereby a manifest loss of 47,340 Rthl accrues to Your Serene Highness.

If to this the Oleśnica loss of 48,000 Rthl be reckoned against the present sale, then Your Serene Highness loses on these two estates a net 95,340 Rthl — and just such a shortfall now arises with the assessment. Trąbczyn

the 2nd of December 1804.

v Triebenfeld

It has 3,792 Morgen and ought to have fetched just as many thousand rt. [uncertain: Mannen]. It has, however, been given away for 10,000 Rthl capital and 918 Rthl interest, and consequently for 28,360 Rthl, whereby a manifest loss of 47,340 Rthl accrues to Your Serene Highness.

summary_en: Von Triebenfeld calculates that the Swięcia estate has been sold off far too cheaply. Glenck's table showed 1,800 Rthl in yearly interest and 10,000 Rthl of capital, whereas the valuers' revision, completed today, yields only 918 Rthl in interest. He says the estate, with 3,792 Morgen, was given away for 28,360 Rthl, which means a loss of 47,340 Rthl. Together with the Oleśnica loss of 48,000 Rthl, the Prince loses a net 95,340 Rthl on both estates. He says a shortfall of the same size is now arising in the valuation.
summary_de: v. Triebenfeld rechnet vor, dass das Gut Swięcia verschleudert worden sei. Glencks Tableau wies 1800 Rthl jährliche Zinsen und 10000 Rthl Capital aus. Die heute beendete Revision der Taxatoren ergibt dagegen nur 918 Rthl Zinsen. Das Gut mit 3792 Morgen sei für 28360 Rthl weggegeben worden, was einen Verlust von 47340 Rthl bedeute. Zusammen mit dem Olesnicer Verlust von 48000 Rthl verliere der Fürst an beiden Gütern netto 95340 Rthl. Ein ebensolcher Ausfall entstehe jetzt bei der Taxe.

reading.notes: Short memo (P. M.) from Triebenfeld to the Prince, dated at Trąbczyn. It works out the loss on the sale of Swięcia. Glenck's table showed 1800 rthl a year in interest and 10000 rt capital. The appraisers' revision, finished that day, gives only 918 rt interest. The estate has 3792 Morgen; it went for an equivalent of 28360 rt, a loss of 47340 rt. With the Olesnica loss of 48000 rt the total is 95340 rthl. The figures are consistent with each other. Unclear words: 'zu künfig' (line 7), 'Mannen' (line 10), 'eben' (line 3).
